description: This file defines an exception class `ChargeIsNotActiveException` which extends `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException`. It is thrown when a charge is found to be inactive in the system, providing specific error message details.

classes.name: ChargeIsNotActiveException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a charge identified by id or name is not active, extending the platform's base exception for domain rule violations.

methods.name: ChargeIsNotActiveException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific charge id and name, constructing an error message indicating the charge is not active.

calls: super("error.msg.charge.is.not.active", "Charge '" + name + "' with identifier " + id + " is not active", name, id)
